correctness.rationale: Average arbitrary pullback pseudometrics over a dihedral group. The seven exhaustive orbit sizes and two graph-path routings give S<=25(x+y+z) and S<=20(x+y)+45z. Positive interpolation gives exactly 125(x+y+t z)/(4+t) in the intermediate regime; monotonicity gives both extremes. With D=5(x+y+t z) and Gamma=(2+t)S/(10D), all displayed coefficients and endpoints follow. Three genuine metric-valued witnesses attain equality for every t>0, and exact-rational code checks routings and nine parameters. No finite test is mistaken for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The conductance-graded GP(5,2) is a canonical graph-orbit perturbation, and its universal nonlinear metric Poincare constant is a natural benchmark for graph embeddings. The result determines an exact global three-phase law, two nontrivial transition values, three concrete equality geometries and an averaged rigidity condition in the intermediate phase. Two distinct all-pairs route load certificates explain the transitions; this is more than a textbook bound or an arbitrary numerical slice.
